# `firearms.support` — root

Every type with its summary and every non-private constructor, method and constant. The
signature is the contract; read the source only when the summary is not enough.

Small helpers shared by more than one of this mod's own Minecraft-facing packages (firearms.component, firearms.item, firearms.data); not part of the pure firearms.model package FA-2 landed (docs/spec/operations/testing.md).

### `class Ids` — `src/main/java/firearms/support/Ids.java`
The one naming rule every data-file-facing enum in this mod follows: a Java constant's own name(), lowercased, is its wire form — in JSON data files (`docs/spec/domains/weapon.md` §3, `docs/spec/domains/attach.md` §3), in item and component registry paths (firearms.item.ItemRegistration), and in firearms:ammo's own caliber field (`docs/spec/contracts/data-contract.md`).
- `String slug(Enum<?> value)` — value.name(), lowercased — Caliber.ACP_45 becomes "acp_45".
